testcase.name: Scenario: Open a workspace panel from the dock tab bar: tmp/obk-docking-native-source-mfi8mlqs/features/application/docking-system/docking-system.feature:82:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Open a workspace panel from the dock tab bar ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And Model is docked and Log is closed ✔ When the user clicks the plus button in the Model dock tab bar ✔ Then the panel menu offers Log Panel, Favorites, Material Browser and Appearance Browser ✔ When the user chooses Log Panel from that menu ✔ Then Log is available beside Model in the same dock tab bar ✔ When the user selects Log and closes its dock tab ✔ Then Log is removed from the tab bar ✔ And Model is still available in the same dock region
